slides.title: Q3 2026 board update
slides.subtitle: Customer Feedback Platform: delivery, revenue and the decisions we need

slides.title: Summary
slides.body: A strong quarter for the platform, with two risks to watch.
bullets: Revenue reached £4.2m, up 18% on Q2, ahead of the £3.9m plan
Gross margin improved to 61% after the hosting migration
Average feedback routing time fell from 42 minutes to 15 minutes
Three enterprise pilots converted to paid contracts (Contoso, Fabrikam, Litware)
Hiring is behind plan: 9 of 14 engineering roles filled
slides.notes: Open with the revenue beat, then the routing time — that is what customers notice. Keep the hiring point honest: we are five roles short and it affects Q1 delivery.
